name: mdk_mcp
description: MDK Neglected Diagnostics MCP - Bioinformatics tools with code execution architecture

scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:workspace && npm run build:code-execution && npm run generate-tools
scripts.build:shared: cd mcp_servers/shared && npm install && npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.build:code-execution: cd code-execution && npm install && npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.clean: npm run clean:shared && npm run clean:workspace && npm run clean:code-execution
scripts.clean:shared: cd mcp_servers/shared && npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist
scripts.clean:code-execution: cd code-execution && npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit && cd mcp_servers/shared && npm run type-check && cd ../.. && cd code-execution && npm run type-check
scripts.postinstall: cd mcp_servers/shared && npm install && cd ../../code-execution && npm install && cd ..
scripts.docker:restart: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:up

author: MDK Design Team
